::: {#fig-grounding-distributed layout-nrow=2}

```{python}
#| label: fig-grounding-distributed-before
#| echo: false
#| fig-cap: "Coupled input: two resistive conductors, floating `F` and retained `Cload`."
import schemdraw as sd
import schemdraw.elements as elm
sd.svgconfig.svg2 = False
with sd.Drawing(canvas='svg') as d:
    d.config(unit=3, fontsize=13)
    elm.Dot().at((0,0)).label('A', loc='top')
    elm.Resistor().right().label(r'$100\,\Omega$')
    elm.Dot().label('A1', loc='top')
    elm.Capacitor().right().label('2 pF')
    elm.Dot().label('B1', loc='top')
    elm.Resistor().right().label(r'$200\,\Omega$')
    elm.Dot().label('B', loc='top')
    elm.Capacitor().at((3,0)).to((4.5,-2)).label('3 pF', loc='top')
    elm.Label().at((4.5,-2)).theta(0).label('F', loc='bottom', ofst=0.2)
    elm.Capacitor().at((4.5,-2)).to((6,0)).label('6 pF', loc='bottom')
    elm.Capacitor().at((3,0)).down().length(4.2).label('1 pF', loc='bottom')
    elm.Capacitor().at((0,0)).down().length(4.2).label('Cload = 5 pF', loc='top')
    elm.Line().at((0,-4.2)).to((3,-4.2))
    elm.Dot().at((3,-4.2)).label('VSS', loc='bottom')
```

```{python}
#| label: fig-grounding-distributed-after
#| echo: false
#| fig-cap: "Grounded output: wire resistors and `Cload` retain their endpoints and values."
import schemdraw as sd
import schemdraw.elements as elm
sd.svgconfig.svg2 = False
with sd.Drawing(canvas='svg') as d:
    d.config(unit=3, fontsize=13)
    elm.Dot().at((0,0)).label('A', loc='top')
    elm.Resistor().right().label(r'$100\,\Omega$')
    elm.Label().at((3,0)).theta(0).label('A1', loc='top', ofst=0.2)
    elm.Capacitor().down().length(3).label('5 pF').color('green')
    elm.Dot().at((9,0)).label('B', loc='top')
    elm.Resistor().left().label(r'$200\,\Omega$')
    elm.Label().at((6,0)).theta(0).label('B1', loc='top', ofst=0.2)
    elm.Capacitor().down().length(3).label('4 pF').color('green')
    elm.Capacitor().at((0,0)).down().length(3).label('Cload = 5 pF', loc='top')
    elm.Line().at((0,-3)).to((6,-3))
    elm.Dot().at((3,-3)).label('VSS', loc='bottom')
```

The example retains the distributed wire resistances. New grounded loads remain at `A1` and `B1`. `Cload` stays at port `A`.

:::
